title: ScapPlatformIdentifier
description: SCAP-sourced archetype — structured technology platform identification per Common Platform Enumeration (CPE) 2.3. Decomposes the CPE Well-Formed Name (WFN) into typed properties enabling Norm predicates against specific technology attributes (vendor, product, version). Cross-cutting identification dimension applicable to any technology-typed subject. Extended by SoftwareTechnology (ITIP domain taxonomy). CCE link: ScapConfigurationSetting.platform references cpeUri as the join key for configuration compliance. Source: NIST IR 7695 (CPE 2.3 Naming), NIST SP 800-126 r3 (SCAP 1.3).

cpeUri.description: Full CPE 2.3 formatted string binding. Format: cpe:2.3:{part}:{vendor}:{product}:{version}:{update}:{edition}:{language}:{sw_edition}:{target_sw}:{target_hw}:{other}. Wildcard '*' matches any value; '-' means not applicable. Source: NIST IR 7695 Section 5 (Formatted String Binding).

part.description: CPE component type. APPLICATION: software application (CPE part 'a'). OPERATING_SYSTEM: operating system (CPE part 'o'). HARDWARE_DEVICE: hardware device (CPE part 'h'). Source: NIST IR 7695 Section 5.3.1.

vendor.description: Person or organization that manufactured or created the product. Source: NIST IR 7695 Section 5.3.2.

product.description: Product name as designated by the vendor. Source: NIST IR 7695 Section 5.3.3.

version.description: Vendor-specific alphanumeric string identifying the particular release version of the product. Source: NIST IR 7695 Section 5.3.4.

update.description: Vendor-specific alphanumeric string identifying the update, service pack, or hotfix installed on the product. Source: NIST IR 7695 Section 5.3.5.

language.description: Language tag per RFC 5646 for the language supported in the user interface of the product. Source: NIST IR 7695 Section 5.3.7.

swEdition.description: How the product is tailored to a particular market or class of end users (e.g., 'online', 'special', 'student'). Source: NIST IR 7695 Section 5.3.8.

targetSw.description: Software computing environment within which the product operates (e.g., operating system, browser, virtualization platform). Source: NIST IR 7695 Section 5.3.9.

targetHw.description: Instruction set architecture or hardware platform on which the product operates (e.g., x86, x86_64, arm64). Source: NIST IR 7695 Section 5.3.10.
